item.title: Sora v1.3.0
item.description:
Sora 1.3.0 | Sulfur
## What's New: - Modules Settings support - AniList sync (Watching/Planing collections)
## Fixes: - Fixed search results being randomized - Fixed bookmark removal causing view to close - Fixed "Mark as Watched" option not showing up - Fixed "Watch Next" button choosing wrong season
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cranci1/Sora/compare/1.2.0...1.3.0
